name: Intent Tags
description: The functional intent behind a pattern - what job it's meant to do

hook.name: Hook
hook.description: Grab attention and create immediate curiosity
hook.question: Does this stop the reader and make them want more?
failureModes: Clickbait: promises more than it delivers
Disconnect: hook doesn't relate to content
qualityTests: Would you keep reading after this sentence?
Does it create genuine curiosity or just confusion?
Is the hook earned by what follows?

frame.name: Frame
frame.description: Establish the lens/context for interpreting what follows
frame.question: Does this tell the reader how to think about what's coming?
failureModes: Invisible: framing is too subtle to register
Heavy-handed: tells reader exactly what to think
Wrong frame: sets up expectations that aren't met
qualityTests: Does the reader know what game we're playing?
Is the framing honest to what follows?
Does it make the argument land harder?

reframe.name: Reframe
reframe.description: Shift the reader's perspective on something they thought they understood
reframe.question: Does this make the reader see something familiar in a new way?
failureModes: Unmotivated: why are we reframing this?
qualityTests: Is there genuine insight in the new frame?
Would the reader's behavior change based on this?
Does the reframe hold up under scrutiny?

crystallization.name: Crystallization
crystallization.description: Compress a complex idea into a clear, memorable formulation
crystallization.question: Could the reader remember and repeat this?
failureModes: Cliché: crystallizes into something already known
qualityTests: Can someone repeat this after one reading?
Does it survive contact with complex reality?
Is it genuinely simpler or just shorter?

pivot.name: Pivot
pivot.description: Execute a turn in the argument's direction
pivot.question: Does this signal and execute a clear change?
failureModes: Weak: direction change is barely perceptible
Lost: reader doesn't know where we're going now
qualityTests: Is the turn clearly signaled?
Is the new direction clear?
Does it feel like progress, not backtracking?

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: Flip expectations or contradict what reader assumed
reversal.question: Did this surprise the reader by contradicting their assumption?
qualityTests: Is the reader genuinely surprised?
Does the reversal hold up logically?
Is there substance behind the surprise?

concede_counterpunch.name: Concede-Counterpunch
concede_counterpunch.description: Acknowledge opposing view then respond with force
concede_counterpunch.question: Does this show fairness then reclaim momentum?
failureModes: Undermined: concession is stronger than counter
qualityTests: Would an opponent recognize their position in the concession?
Does the counterpunch actually address the concession?
Does the sequence build or lose credibility?

build_momentum.name: Build Momentum
build_momentum.question: Does this make the reader feel growing force?
qualityTests: Is each beat genuinely adding force?
Can the reader sustain this energy?
Is there a payoff coming for this buildup?

slow_down.name: Slow Down
slow_down.description: Reduce pace for emphasis, reflection, or precision
slow_down.question: Does this create productive pause in the flow?
failureModes: Momentum killer: breaks flow that was working
qualityTests: Does the pause add meaning?
Does the reader need to catch breath here?
Is there sufficient energy to resume after?

summarize.name: Summarize
summarize.question: Does this capture what matters without losing it?
qualityTests: Could someone skip the detail and just read this?
Does it capture the most important elements?
Does it add compression or just remove content?

foreshadow.name: Foreshadow
foreshadow.description: Hint at what's coming without fully revealing
foreshadow.question: Does this create anticipation for something ahead?
qualityTests: Does the reader feel anticipation without frustration?
Is the payoff worth the setup?
Is the foreshadowing subtle enough?

callback.name: Callback
callback.description: Reference earlier content to create closure or emphasis
callback.question: Does this reward the reader for paying attention?
failureModes: Unclear: reader doesn't remember what's being referenced
qualityTests: Does the reader remember the original?
Does the callback add new meaning?
Does it create satisfying closure?
